title: 执行操作后字典序最小的字符串
key_insight: 操作空间有限，BFS枚举所有可能的字符串状态
approach: BFS/DFS枚举所有rotate和add操作的结果
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def findLexSmallestString(self, s: str, a: int, b: int) -> str:
        visited = set()
        queue = [s]
        visited.add(s)
        res = s
        while queue:
            cur = queue.pop(0)
            res = min(res, cur)
            added = list(cur)
            for i in range(1, len(added), 2):
                added[i] = str((int(added[i]) + a) % 10)
            added = ''.join(added)
            if added not in visited:
                visited.add(added)
                queue.append(added)
            rotated = cur[b:] + cur[:b]
            if rotated not in visited:
                visited.add(rotated)
                queue.append(rotated)
        return res

title: 销售价值减少的颜色球
key_insight: 二分找到卖到的最低价格，然后计算总收入
approach: 二分答案找到截断高度，用等差数列求和
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, inventory, orders: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        inventory.sort(reverse=True)
        inventory.append(0)
        res = 0
        width = 0
        for i in range(len(inventory) - 1):
            width += 1
            if inventory[i] > inventory[i+1]:
                sell = inventory[i] - inventory[i+1]
                total = width * sell
                if total <= orders:
                    # sum from inventory[i] down to inventory[i+1]+1, width times
                    hi, lo = inventory[i], inventory[i+1] + 1
                    res = (res + width * (hi + lo) * sell // 2) % MOD
                    orders -= total
                else:
                    full_rows = orders // width
                    remainder = orders % width
                    hi = inventory[i]
                    lo = hi - full_rows + 1
                    res = (res + width * (hi + lo) * full_rows // 2) % MOD
                    res = (res + remainder * (lo - 1)) % MOD
                    orders = 0
                    break
        return res % MOD

title: 到家的最少跳跃次数
key_insight: BFS搜索状态(位置, 上一步方向)，注意后退不能连续
approach: BFS扩展，状态为(pos, is_backward)，forbidden用集合快速判断
code_python3:
from collections import deque
class Solution:
    def minimumJumps(self, forbidden, a: int, b: int, x: int) -> int:
        ban = set(forbidden)
        upper = max(max(forbidden) + a + b, x + b) + 1
        visited = set()
        visited.add((0, False))
        queue = deque([(0, False, 0)])
        while queue:
            pos, back, steps = queue.popleft()
            if pos == x:
                return steps
            # forward
            nxt = pos + a
            if nxt <= upper and nxt not in ban and (nxt, False) not in visited:
                visited.add((nxt, False))
                queue.append((nxt, False, steps + 1))
            # backward
            if not back:
                nxt = pos - b
                if nxt >= 0 and nxt not in ban and (nxt, True) not in visited:
                    visited.add((nxt, True))
                    queue.append((nxt, True, steps + 1))
        return -1

title: 使数组互补的最少操作次数
key_insight: 对每对(nums[i], nums[n-1-i])分析使其和为T所需操作数，用差分数组统计
approach: 差分数组统计每个可能的目标和T需要的总操作数
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minMoves(self, nums, limit: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        diff = [0] * (2 * limit + 2)
        for i in range(n // 2):
            a, b = nums[i], nums[n-1-i]
            lo = min(a, b) + 1
            hi = max(a, b) + limit
            s = a + b
            # default 2 ops for all T in [2, 2*limit]
            diff[2] += 2
            diff[2*limit+1] -= 2
            # 1 op for T in [lo, hi]
            diff[lo] -= 1
            diff[hi+1] += 1
            # 0 op for T = s
            diff[s] -= 1
            diff[s+1] += 1
        res = float('inf')
        cur = 0
        for t in range(2, 2*limit+1):
            cur += diff[t]
            res = min(res, cur)
        return res

title: 数组的最小偏移量
key_insight: 将所有奇数乘2统一为偶数形式，然后用最大堆不断将最大值除2
approach: 统一为最大可能值后用最大堆贪心缩小范围
code_python3:
import heapq
class Solution:
    def minimumDeviation(self, nums) -> int:
        heap = []
        min_val = float('inf')
        for num in nums:
            if num % 2:
                num *= 2
            heapq.heappush(heap, -num)
            min_val = min(min_val, num)
        res = -heap[0] - min_val
        while heap[0] % 2 == 0:
            top = -heapq.heappop(heap)
            top //= 2
            min_val = min(min_val, top)
            heapq.heappush(heap, -top)
            res = min(res, -heap[0] - min_val)
        return res
